fields.description: Velora offers three- and four-bedroom townhouses within The Valley’s second phase. Large windows, terraces and planted surroundings connect the homes with outdoor spaces. Emaar presents the neighbourhood as a gated setting for active family life, with walking routes, recreation and landscaped areas close to the residential streets.

overview: Velora’s own cluster plan places a community centre near flexible lawns and children’s spaces. A hills walk and sports court add places for everyday activity, while an entrance guardhouse defines the residential enclave. Check how each plot relates to those facilities when comparing privacy, outlook and walking distance.
research.locationNote: Velora belongs to The Valley on the Dubai–Al Ain Road corridor. Its suburban setting relies on road connections to the rest of Dubai. Check the actual entrance and commute for a selected home; map labels and promotional journey times are not transport guarantees.
research.priceNote: Emaar displays AED 2.48m. The brochure’s Velora commercial table gives AED 2.48m for three bedrooms and AED 2.84m for four. Property Finder’s current-listing headline differs. Launch prices and current resale offers should not be treated as equivalent quotations.
research.paymentNote: Launch terms are 10% booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% on completion. The schedule includes construction-linked conditions. Confirm the remaining balance and payment dates applicable to the individual sale.
research.handoverNote: The Velora payment sheet estimates August 2028, matching Property Finder. This is distinct from Venera’s September schedule. Delivery remains subject to the contract and current developer confirmation.

facts.label: Reported development scale
facts.value: The reproduced FY2025 Emaar presentation lists 488 Velora homes. This is a historical project count, not available stock.

facts.label: Area basis
facts.value: Plan totals include suite, garage and balcony/terrace space. They are separate from land area and vary by position within each four-home block.

facts.label: Launch plot averages
facts.value: The Velora commercial table gives average plots of 1,952 sq ft for three bedrooms and 3,289 sq ft for four. These averages are not individual plot measurements.

facts.label: Home layout
facts.value: Two-level plans include enclosed kitchens, maid’s rooms, carports and terraces. Four-bedroom examples have a ground-floor guest room and three bedrooms upstairs.

unresolved: The shared brochure contains differing average built-up figures. Use the individual Velora floor-plan tables and signed unit schedule for size comparisons.
Payment and cluster documents are Emaar-branded broker-hosted copies. The developer-issued current terms and final specification need confirmation.
